summary: Verified RTF element edit/save bug fix. Backend tests (10/10 passed) confirm PUT /api/projects/{id}/slides/{id}/elements/{id} with htmlContent works correctly. Frontend E2E tests confirm: editing existing HTML elements shows success toast 'Texto atualizado!' and content persists, creating new HTML elements via 'Texto com IA' button works with 'Texto adicionado ao slide!' success toast.
passed_tests: ✅ Backend: htmlContent field persists in database after update
✅ Backend: Other element fields (x, y, width, height) preserved during htmlContent update

✅ Frontend: Content persists after save (verified by re-opening element)

critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix correctly implemented: editingHtmlSlideId stores slideId when opening edit dialog
handleAddRichTextToSlide now uses stored slideId instead of potentially stale currentSlide.id
updateElement/addElement in ProjectContext properly throw errors when missing required params
rtfSaveFailed flag prevents clearing content on dialog close if save failed
context_for_next_testing_agent: RTF element edit/save bug is FIXED. The bug was that handleAddRichTextToSlide used currentSlide.id which could be null/stale when slide changed during editing. Fix stores slideId (editingHtmlSlideId) when opening the dialog and uses it for save. Key test IDs: data-testid='slide-{index}' for slides, data-testid='element-{id}' for elements, data-testid='add-rich-text-btn' for new text button.
